newsitem.title: USA: TCF Financial to buy back up to 1.7 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: TCF Financial to buy back up to 1.7 mln shrs.

text.p: TCF Financial Corp said Monday its board of directors has authorized the repurchase of up to five percent of the company's common stock, or about 1.7 million shares.

The shares will be repurchased from time to time, depending upon market conditions, through open market or privately negotiated transactions, the company said, adding that the repurchased shares will become treasury shares.

TCF has 337,688 shares remaining unpurchased in its current five percent stock repurchase program, authorized by the board of directors in December 1995, which the company expects to repurchase before initiating the new program, the bank holding company said.
At December 31, 1996, TCF had 34.8 million common shares outstanding, the company said.
TCF shares were up 5/8 at 42-5/8 Monday.
